basics.headline: Machine learning engineer and researcher
basics.summary: Final-year computer science student who builds applied machine learning systems end to end, from data pipelines and model training to FastAPI services on Google Cloud. Research interest in parameter-efficient fine-tuning for vision models.
basics.work_authorization: Citizen of India; authorised to work in India without sponsorship. Would require visa sponsorship for roles based outside India.
basics.availability: Available for a 6-month internship from January 2027 or full-time from July 2027.

experience.description: Worked on the document intelligence team building classification services for scanned insurance forms.
achievements: Built a PyTorch document classifier served through FastAPI that routes scanned insurance forms to the right review queue
Reduced manual labelling time by 35% by adding an active-learning loop to the annotation workflow
Containerised the service with Docker and deployed it to Google Cloud Run with CI on GitHub Actions
Shipped a React and TypeScript inventory dashboard used by 40 store managers
Wrote Node.js REST APIs backed by PostgreSQL for stock-level alerts

projects.name: Campus RAG Assistant
projects.description: Retrieval-augmented chatbot that answers student questions from university handbooks and notices.
highlights: Indexed 2,000+ handbook pages with pgvector and hybrid keyword search
Added source citations to every answer so students can verify responses
metrics: Answered 1,200+ student queries during a four-week pilot

projects.name: LeafScan
projects.description: Plant disease detection from smartphone photos using a fine-tuned convolutional network.
highlights: Fine-tuned a ResNet-50 on a curated subset of a public plant-disease dataset
Shipped an offline Flutter app with an on-device quantised model
metrics: 94% top-1 accuracy on the held-out test split

projects.name: TripBoard
projects.description: Collaborative trip planner with shared itineraries and budgets.
highlights: Real-time shared editing of itineraries for groups of friends

research.title: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning of vision transformers for medical imaging
research.description: Studying low-rank adaptation and distillation to adapt vision transformers to small chest X-ray datasets.
outcomes: Reduced trainable parameters by 90% with under 1 point accuracy drop on the validation set

publications.title: Low-Rank Adaptation of Vision Transformers for Small Chest X-ray Datasets

achievements.title: First place, Northbridge AI Hackathon
achievements.description: Built an accessibility assistant that reads medicine labels aloud, in a team of four.

achievements.title: Teaching Assistant, Machine Learning
achievements.description: Ran weekly lab sessions for 60 second-year students.

answers.question: Are you legally authorised to work in India?
answers.answer: Yes. I am a citizen of India.

answers.question: Will you now or in the future require visa sponsorship?
answers.answer: Not for roles in India. I would require sponsorship for roles based outside India.
